posts.author: Pheonix KageDesu
posts.body:
Equipment Menu 1.0
Pheonix KageDesu
​
Plugin change default equip menu (scene) to alternative one with slots insted of list. You can edit slots positions, windows positions and sizes.
How to Use:
Plugin and Play. All actual plugin instructions and commands are listed in the plugin help section
Plugin webpage
Download:
Works in RPG Maker MZ and MV
Download
Terms of Use:
Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution, Share Alike, Non-Commercial
(Attribution Non-Commercial Share Alike, cc by-nc-sa)
You can use plugin in
non-commercial projects for free
For using plugin in commercial projects you should obtain PRO version of plugin
